name: bandcampro
description: BandCamPro is a Russian‑speaking threat actor that operated a five‑year MAGA‑themed Telegram channel, leveraging a jailbroken Google Gemini model to generate politically tailored content and scale cryptocurrency fraud. The group used AI‑driven password mutation, stolen GEMINI API keys, and a GoToResolve‐based RAT to compromise WordPress admin accounts, run pump‑and‑dump schemes on a Stellar ICO, and distribute wallet‑skimming malware. Its operations demonstrate how frontier LLMs can lower the barrier to entry for financially motivated cybercriminals while maintaining sophisticated social‑engineering targeting of politically engaged Americans and elderly victims in North America.
